name: mobilegym_list_search
description: Deterministic long-list target finding tasks for evaluating repeated mobile scrolling and precise item selection.

global_reset.prompt: 请把设备准备到“列表实验室”的列表顶部：如果不在该应用，先回到主屏幕并打开“列表实验室”；如果在详情页，先返回列表；最后滚动到列表最顶部。准备好后简短回复。

tasks.prompt: 请在当前列表中通过滚动找到并打开那条“周四下班前领取蓝色雨伞，登记尾号 7312”的记录。不要使用搜索功能。
tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must scroll through Scroll Lab and open exactly the detail page for the record titled 取回蓝色雨伞, whose preview says to collect a blue umbrella before Thursday work ends using registration suffix 7312. It is the fixed medium-depth target at list position 24 of 100.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Scroll Lab detail page with the exact title '取回蓝色雨伞', preview containing '尾号 7312', position 24 / 100, record code SL-024, and a visible selected-state confirmation.

tasks.prompt: 请在当前列表中通过滚动找到并打开那条“到北门 3 号柜领取银色保温箱，核验码 K4M7”的记录。不要使用搜索功能。
tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must repeatedly scroll through Scroll Lab and open exactly the detail page for the record titled 冷链样品交接, whose preview says to collect a silver insulated case from north gate locker 3 using verification code K4M7. It is the fixed deep target at list position 83 of 100.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows the Scroll Lab detail page with the exact title '冷链样品交接', preview containing '银色保温箱' and 'K4M7', position 83 / 100, record code SL-083, and a visible selected-state confirmation.
